movie.title: 2 Big to Rig
movie.overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Filmed in 16mm at two sold-out Mexico City shows, this concert documentary delivers the ultimate live GHOST ritual featuring exclusive backstage access and historic footage of Papa V Perpetua.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Captured live during two sold-out shows in Mexico City, 2 BIG TO RIG brings the spectacle of GHOST’s SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR to audiences worldwide, including select IMAX® locations. As the exclusive pro-shot document of the phone-free tour, the film combines powerful live performances with unmasked, behind-the-scenes moments. Designed specifically for fans in regions where staging the massive production was logistically impossible, it stands as a cinematic love letter to the band's global fanbase. Visually enriched by 16mm film, the performance covers tracks across six studio albums alongside fan-favorite non-LP tracks.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: 2 BIG TO RIG serves as the definitive concert film documenting heavy metal band GHOST during their iconic SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR. Captured over two sold-out nights in Mexico City, the movie brings the high-octane energy of the band's theatrical live rituals directly to moviegoers and select IMAX® screens. This release marks the only professional multi-camera recording of Papa V Perpetua alongside his Nameless Ghouls from the strict phone-free tour experience. Beyond the stage, the film offers fans unprecedented behind-the-scenes access and intimate backstage footage of the band in motion. Created intentionally for followers in territories where bringing the massive stage show was logistically impossible, the project acts as a dedicated love letter to the global GHOST community. Shot entirely on 16mm film, the visual presentation provides a unique, raw texture that elevates the band's dark, theatrical aesthetic. The setlist spans material from all six of GHOST's studio albums, including their 2025 chart-topping release SKELETÁ. Fans are also treated to live renditions of non-album hits such as 'Mary On A Cross,' 'Kiss the Go-Goat,' and 'The Future is a Foreign Land.' Ultimately, 2 BIG TO RIG captures a pivotal era of the band in peak performance, delivering an immersive cinematic ritual.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Shot on 16mm film across two sold-out nights in Mexico City, 2 BIG TO RIG offers an immersive concert and documentary experience capturing GHOST's SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR. Featuring exclusive pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and the Nameless Ghouls from their phone-free shows, the film weaves together high-energy stage performances with rare behind-the-scenes access. Designed to bring the live ritual to fans worldwide—especially in regions where the tour could not logistically travel—the setlist highlights music from six studio albums, including 2025's SKELETÁ, along with standalone hits like 'Mary On A Cross.'

story_structure.climax: The concert reaches its peak intensity as GHOST delivers show-stopping performances of iconic non-LP anthems like 'Mary On A Cross' and 'Kiss the Go-Goat' in front of a sold-out crowd.
story_structure.conflict: The challenge of translating the immense scale and energy of a live phone-free arena show into a narrative film experience for fans worldwide who could not attend in person.
story_structure.resolution: The experience concludes as a heartfelt love letter to the faithful fanbase, successfully capturing the definitive document of the SKELETOUR ritual for IMAX screens.
story_structure.introduction: The ritual begins as Papa V Perpetua and the Nameless Ghouls take the stage in Mexico City, introducing audiences to the cinematic 16mm atmosphere of the SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR.
story_structure.risingAction: The band powers through a career-spanning setlist of favorites and tracks from SKELETÁ, interspersed with exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and intimate backstage access.
